dedupe_keys.name: space environment prediction center sepc 空间环境预报中心

description: The Space Environment Prediction Center publishes space weather forecasts, alerts and data for China: daily, weekly and monthly forecasts and summaries, 27-day forecasts of F10.7 and Ap, solar cycle forecasts, alerts for X-ray flares, solar proton events, geomagnetic storms and high-energy electron storms, and model forecasts of the AE, Dst and Kp indices, sudden ionospheric disturbances, magnetopause position and ionospheric TEC. It belongs to the National Space Science Center of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and also offers spacecraft services from design to anomaly diagnosis and debris warnings. Data sharing covers solar imaging from the Huairou station, three-component geomagnetic data, a K index nowcast model tuned to Chinese stations, cosmic rays from Beijing and Guangzhou, ionospheric scintillation and critical frequency, and daily environment data. Coverage is global drivers with Chinese station data, updated from five-minute to daily. Format and access: Chinese-language web pages, plots and bulletins, without login for the public products. Licence: not stated; copyright of the centre; free to view. Caveats: no English interface or bulk download was found on the home page. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response for satellites, grids and GNSS. Related catalogue records are the NOAA SWPC products and the Chinese Meridian Project data centre.
